chunks: Ibn Faḍḍāl narrated from Thaʿlabah ibn Maymūn, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

“When you purchase a bondwoman, then say: O Allah, I seek Your counsel and I seek Your choosing. And when you purchase a riding animal or livestock, then say: O Allah, decree for me the one among them longest in life, greatest in benefit, and best in outcome.”

key_terms.أَسْتَخِيرُكَ: I ask You to choose what is best
key_terms.أَسْتَشِيرُكَ: I seek Your counsel in the matter
key_terms.جَارِيَةً: a bondwoman or female slave being purchased

ai.seo_question: What supplication should be recited when purchasing an animal or bondwoman?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a du'a to be recited when purchasing a bondwoman, an animal, or livestock. It emphasizes turning to Allah for counsel, good choice, benefit, longevity, and a favorable outcome in worldly transactions.
